name: Izunokuni (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Izunokuni city emblem in purple and green: a purple stylised mountain above a green stylised swoosh.
history: Municipal flag of Izunokuni, a city in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 2005.

features.role: Izunokuni city emblem — a purple stylised mountain above a green stylised swoosh
